format_details.weight_only_per_channel: dequantized to FP32, then as fp32
format_details.weight_only_per_tensor: dequantized to FP32, then as fp32
format_details.ptq_static: saved fused INT8 TorchScript (torch.jit.script), loaded as is
format_details.qat: saved fused INT8 TorchScript (torch.jit.script), loaded as is
format_details.pruned / control: whole saved FP32 module (pruning/structured/filter/models), fuse_model(), torch.jit.trace
format_details.sparse: whole saved FP32 module with exact zeros (pruning/unstructured/models), fuse_model(), torch.jit.trace; dense kernels
format_details.blocks: whole saved FP32 module, removed blocks are nn.Identity (pruning/structured/whole_block/models), fuse_model() + Conv-BN(-ReLU) Sequential fusion, torch.jit.trace

peak_memory: psutil RSS, sampled every 1 ms during load + warm-up
flops_counted_on: fused FP32 architecture, for every model
